timeline.summary: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways (promoter) declared no encumbrance on SCILAL’s equity shares for FY 2025-26 under SEBI Regulation 31.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹5.81 Cr (+19.1% YoY), net loss ₹0.84 Cr (against a loss of ₹224.37 Cr a year earlier).
On May 6, 2026, SCI signed an MoU with NBCC for the upgradation and construction of infrastructure at MTI Powai, an asset owned by SCILAL.
Shipping Corporation of India Land and Assets reported board comments on ₹9.8 Lakh exchange fines for Q3 FY26 board composition lapses.
